name: musical-ecosystem-foundation
description: Perfect, bulletproof foundation for musical ecosystem and school

scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:clean && npm run build:msm && npm run build:cubes && npm run build:organize
scripts.build:msm: cd apps/million-song-mind && npm run build && cd ../..
scripts.build:organize: cp -r apps/million-song-mind/dist/* dist/ && rm -rf dist/obs-cubes dist/MusicViz "dist/obs-cubes removed" && mkdir -p dist/obsidian && cp -r Obsidian/* dist/obsidian/ && echo 'Deployment build complete with Obsidian'
scripts.build:copy-files: mkdir -p MusicViz && cp -r apps/million-song-mind/dist/* MusicViz/ && mkdir -p Obsidian && cp -r apps/obsidian-angular/dist/novaxe-obsidian/browser/* Obsidian/
scripts.postinstall: echo '🎵 Musical Ecosystem Foundation Ready!' && ./dev-server.sh status
